text:
zoe: quick thread on the latency card micro-interactions. i'm polishing the p95 overlay + sampling legend and want feedback on keyboard discoverability and colorblind-safe palettes.

emma: love it. quick priority: keyboard focus should land on the legend item that toggles bucket outlines. currently it's not tabbable.

ryan: agree. also add a visible focus ring that contrasts well on dark and light themes. use the system focus color variable so it matches other controls.

nate: colorblind note: the current heatmap ramps from blue->purple->red. for deuteranopia we lose the purple step. propose swapping to a blue->teal->orange ramp or adding textured pattern overlay for the highest bin.

zoe: pattern overlay could be noisy at normal zoom. what if we only enable pattern for accessibility mode (user setting) and otherwise rely on color changes + halo?

emma: that sounds reasonable. also microcopy: the legend toggle should read "Bucket outlines" not "Show buckets" so it’s clear it's an outline affordance. tooltip: "Toggle bucket boundaries (helps with exact value debugging)."

ryan: keyboard interactions: when user tabs to the sampling legend, hitting space toggles it. introduce a secondary keybinding (Shift+Enter) to temporarily enable bucket outlines while key is held? but keyboard shouldn't require holding for accessibility. maybe map "b" while focused to cycle bucket modes (off, hover-only, persistent).

nate: careful with single-letter shortcuts conflicting with other app shortcuts. prefer a visible on-legend menu with 3 radio options so screen readers get semantics. radios are keyboard-friendly and clear.

zoe: good point. radio group with label "Bucket outline mode" and description: "Off, Hover markers, Persistent". default to Hover markers. aria-describedby points to the microcopy explaining perf impact.

emma: p95 overlay: when buckets are softened we still want precise numeric readouts. propose hover state shows a transient tooltip listing bucket center + count + p95 value with a small chevron to pin it. ensure tooltip is reachable via keyboard (focusable) so screen readers can read the numbers.

ryan: implementation detail: the server can return an array of bucketCenters and p95s for the drawn window. client can interpolate p95 line from raw values to keep trend continuity but snap tooltips to bucket centers. this avoids misleading visual discretization.

nate: copy for low-sampling ribbon: "Low sample density may exaggerate short spikes. Consider increasing sample density or using persistent bucket outlines for debugging." Keep it short.

zoe: interactions for mobile: legend radios should collapse into a full-screen sheet. ensure the sheet has a heading and large touch targets.

emma: accessibility check: when user changes bucket mode, announce via aria-live: "Bucket outlines set to Hover markers". Add aria-pressed states for the legend button.

ryan: analytics: track events: bucket_mode_changed, p95_tooltip_pinned, sampling_density_changed with previous/next values to study defaults.

zoe: final ask: nate/emma can you produce a small spec gif showing keyboard tab -> focus ring -> open legend -> change radio -> aria-live message? ryan will wire server payload for bucket centers. i'll draft the copy for the tooltip and ribbon.

dev-bot: reminder: add accessibility checklist to the PR template and include colorblind palette preview screenshots.

zoe: thanks all 163; aiming to ship as a small UX polish in next sprint. any objections?

emma: none from me.

ryan: good to go.

nate: thumbs up.

zoe: perfect, i'll file the design PR with assets.
